
Usage:   deno deploy env load <file>
Version: 0.0.9909                   

Description:

  Load environment variables from a .env file into the application

Options:

  --org                  <name>     - The name of the organization                                                               
  --app                  <name>     - The name of the application                                                                
  -h, --help                        - Show this help.                                                                            
  --token                <token>    - Auth token to use                                                                          
  --config               <config>   - Path for the config file                                                                   
  --ignore               <path>     - Ignore particular source files                                                             
  -q, --quiet                       - Suppress non-essential output                                                              
  -j, --json                        - Emit JSON on stdout instead of human-readable output                                       
  -y, --non-interactive             - Fail fast instead of prompting; values must be supplied via flags or env vars (alias: -y)  
  --non-secrets          <keys...>  - Which keys in the .env file to treat as non-secrets                                        
  --replace                         - Replace existing env vars without prompting                                                
  --skip-existing                   - Skip existing env vars without prompting                                                   

Examples:

  Load from .env file        load .env                     
  Replace existing variables load --replace .env.production
